note: Owner-requested historical-scale reassessment of existing r001 evidence. Same affiliated assistant, not blinded. Existing numeric rules, no new creation or gameplay observations, no original-score rewrite. Ratings are criterion-based operator judgements. Capture gaps and owner-tab anomalies remain limitations.

opens.reason: Clean anonymous start has empty readable board/state and a playable falling piece.

gravity_next.reason: Idle descent then visibly faster ArrowDown descent; score 0→3 matches three soft-drop inputs. Three successive locks (floor and stack), retained locked pieces and new spawns.

move_bounds.reason: Same L moves both ways and clamps at both walls.

rotate.reason: Asymmetric L rotates in open space and at the left wall without crossing boundaries.

stack.reason: Three successive locks (floor and stack), retained locked pieces and new spawns.

line_clear.reason: Full bottom row removed by normal input and upper blocks collapse; a later two-row removal also captured.

line_clear_score.reason: At level 1, single 102→234 with explicit +100 clear reward; double 568→898 with explicit +300 reward, lines 1→3. Drop contributions 32/30 cannot explain clear awards.

top_out.reason: Normal hard-drops cause explicit loss at 263; subsequent direction/rotation/down inputs leave normal placement stopped.

restart_reset.reason: Post-loss visible restart empties board and current score; new ArrowLeft input works. Historical best correctly persists.

discoverable_controls.reason: Start overlay explains direction controls and Space; labeled buttons match recorded inputs. The keyboard rotation key is not explicitly explained in the entry instructions.

clear_information.reason: Current score, best, level, line count and next piece remain organized and readable across empty, stacked and loss states. Evidence supports consistent multi-state clarity, not a perfect rating.

board_legibility.reason: Grid, board limits and colored pieces are clear in empty and populated states. No ghost was requested; depth/shading and stacks remain readable in the tested layouts.

visual_consistency.reason: Pastel block styling, panels and buttons are consistent through play, loss and restart and fit both recorded viewports. Physical-device operation and broader layouts were not established.

feedback_pacing.reason: Input/locking, clear messages/particles and loss are visibly distinct. Pale green clear text has low contrast against the board and effects overlap blocks; sampled screenshots do not establish frame pacing or audio quality.

session_flow.reason: Start, top-out, restart and working input after restart are demonstrated in the anonymous session. Decorative blocks behind the initial start modal can confuse the initial board state. Unattributed owner-tab anomalies are separately disclosed, not attributed as a confirmed product bug.

user_cost.reason: Owner-reported model/media cost is a provider estimate, not an actual user charge, credit valuation or subscription allocation.
